Definition: from G5228 and G5426; to esteem oneself overmuch, i.e. be vain or arrogant:--think more highly.
BiblicalUsage: In the New Testament, hyperphronéō is the word for think more highly. In Romans 12:3, the text says "not to think [of himself] more highly than he ought to think."
TheologicalSignificance: I take hyperphronéō as it stands: think more highly.
